input.title: [Android] Blue highlight flashes when user taps and holds on the uncovered scroll area of the Homescreen during Sidebar Menu onscreen
input.body:
## Step to reproduce
1. Open em app
2. Tap Hamburger button
3. Tap and hold the uncovered scroll area of the Homescreen on the far right hand side


## Current behavior
Blue highlight flashes on screen.
Note: tapping the Sidebar Menu does not trigger this issue

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8bb3aadf-63c2-4f5e-a0ea-64854226ac35

## Expected behavior
Nothing should happens.
Blue highlight should not be flashed
